paragraphs: STREAMETRIC sells cloud SCADA software for utilities of all sizes, reached from any device through one platform. The software is provided as a service, which reduces the need for a utility to run its own server and IT infrastructure. Core functions are control, alarm notifications, data storage and visualization, plus prediction models for water and wastewater applications.

Applications shown on the site are water plant and distribution, collection and lift station, and AI-Flow and I&I monitoring. The about page states a mission to empower utilities of all sizes to provide safe and reliable water and wastewater services to the people. Installations and technical support are provided by selected Representatives with a local footprint in the customer's area.

The team is described as having over 50 years of combined experience in SCADA, software, water and connectivity. Headquarters is in Raleigh, NC, with business development specialists across the country. STREAMETRIC is part of MANN+HUMMEL Group, a filtration company with decades of experience in the water and wastewater market.
